items.t: Official boundary: the City of Chilliwack publishes no boundary for the East Chilliwack name.

faq.q: How do I find my child's catchment school?
faq.a: SD33 catchments are address-based — run the exact address in the district's School Locator; no catchment for an East Chilliwack address is stated in this file because none was run in this pass.

faq.q: How do I check if a parcel is in the Agricultural Land Reserve?
faq.a: Agricultural Land Reserve status is per address — check the parcel on the Agricultural Land Commission mapping, and note the AL zone's subdivision minimums (7.5 ha, or 0.2 ha for an ALC-approved homesite severance) if subdivision is part of the plan.

The City floodplain bylaw sets 60 m from the Fraser River, 75 m from the Vedder River and 30 m from the Chilliwack River and Vedder Canal as minimum building setbacks; which watercourses affect a given East Chilliwack parcel is a per-property check.
